ADD MY EDITIONS TO SOHINI'S TREE

```{r}
### I am going to remove from the tree strains 121 that never grew, 018 that produced too much EPS, and strain 067 that I did not included in the anthrone assessment. 

tips_to_remove <- c("AVT121", "AVT18", "AVT67")
tree_filt <- drop.tip(tree, tips_to_remove)

#########


### THESE FILES COME FROM MY ANALYSIS 
### To join with the meta data is have the new names to replace the AVT with my label. 

### The excel file to change the codes that Sohini uses 

Codes <- read_excel("/Users/mariaalejandragilpolo/Downloads/Strain_codes_ForTree.xlsx")
## Change the meta column name "Strain" for "Strain_Code"

## Now I am going to merge with Codes

### Get the Gluose values
Shoot_fitness_OD_ForTree_ave <- Shoot_fitness_OD %>%
  group_by(Strain) %>%
  summarise(Glucose_OD600_ave = mean(Glucose_OD600))
### Change the Name of the Strain column for "Strain_Code" and keep that title consistant. 
Shoot_fitness_OD_ForTree_ave <- Shoot_fitness_OD_ForTree_ave %>% dplyr::rename(Strain_Code = Strain)

Codes_glucose <- merge(Codes, Shoot_fitness_OD_ForTree_ave, by = "Strain_Code")
#View(Codes_glucose)
# Remove 121 and 018
Codes_glucose <- Codes_glucose %>% filter(!(Strain_Code %in% c("018", "121"))) ## This already did no have 067 because I forgot to streak it 

####



#View(Codes_glucose)
meta_tree <- meta_raw %>%
  select(-any_of("label")) %>%
  left_join(
    Codes_glucose %>%
      select(-any_of("label")) %>%
      select(Strain, Strain_Code, Pairs, Glucose_OD600_ave),
    by = "Strain"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = Strain,
    Morphology = recode(Morphology,
                        "R" = "Mucoid",
                        "P" = "Dry"),
    Morphology = factor(Morphology, levels = c("Mucoid", "Dry")),
    pair_status = ifelse(is.na(Pairs), "No pair", "Paired")
  ) %>%
  filter(!label %in% tips_to_remove) ### Remove these from the metadata


meta_tree_plot <- meta_tree %>%
  select(label, Strain_Code, Morphology, Pairs, Glucose_OD600_ave) %>%
  mutate(
    Morphology = factor(Morphology, levels = c("Mucoid", "Dry")),
    Pairs = ifelse(is.na(Pairs), "No pair", as.character(Pairs)),
    Pairs = factor(Pairs),
    Pair_label = ifelse(Pairs == "No pair", "", as.character(Pairs))
  )

# Morphology
morph_cols <- c(
  "Mucoid" = "#4eadb9",
  "Dry" = "#e0ba3e"
)

# Pair

pair_levels <- levels(meta_tree_plot$Pairs)

pair_cols <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(length(pair_levels), palette = "Dynamic"),
  pair_levels
)

if ("No pair" %in% names(pair_cols)) {
  pair_cols["No pair"] <- "white"
}



### I run into a problem with duplications of columns with meta_tree so I am subsetting it 
label_df <- meta_tree_plot %>%
  select(label, Strain_Code)

p <- ggtree(tree_filt, branch.length = "none") %<+% label_df +
  geom_tiplab(aes(label = Strain_Code), size = 2.8, offset = 0.02) +
  theme_tree2() +
  xlim_tree(4)


p

## Add the morphology
p <- p +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree_plot %>% select(label, Morphology),
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = "Morphology", fill = Morphology),
    width = 1,
    offset = 0.04,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = morph_cols,
    name = "Morphology"
  )


## Add glucose
p <- p +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree_plot %>% select(label, Glucose_OD600_ave),
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = "Glucose", fill = Glucose_OD600_ave),
    width = 1,
    offset = 0.03,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
        color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d8031c",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#01016f",
    midpoint = median(meta_tree_plot$Glucose_OD600_ave, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "Glucose"
  )





## Add the pair
p <- p +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree_plot %>% select(label, Pairs),
    geom = geom_tile,
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = "Pair", fill = Pairs),
    width = 1,
    offset = 0.03,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pair_cols,
    name = "Pair"
  ) +
  geom_fruit(
    data = meta_tree_plot %>% select(label, Pair_label),
    geom = geom_text,
    mapping = aes(y = label, x = "Pair", label = Pair_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.2,
    color = "black"
  )

ggsave(
  "AVT_tree_all.pdf_withlegends.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 15,
  units = "in"
)

#no legends
p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
p
ggsave(
  "AVT_tree_all.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 20,
  units = "in"
)










```
